Upload all photos as references and run the Product Sheet template. Review, regenerate if needed, and save the best sheet for later shots.

Use the uploaded product sheet as the reference. Keep the [PRODUCT] exactly the same — same shape, same colour, same details, same text and logo, do not redesign it.
